item: Black Iron Helmet / 黑铁头盔
classification: project-generated presentation asset based on verified classic evidence
anchorUsage: same-cell position/motion and death-facing calibration only; no anchor-source pixels copied

deathPoseBaseline.mappingRule: Every record is the same direction row and death-frame column in warrior_death.png, Helmet.wil and Hair.wil.
deathPoseBaseline.rendererPolicy: A renderer must consume all 32 records independently; it may not copy one direction's death pose into another direction.

sourceEvidence.runtimeFinding: DrawHead uses HairLibrary; no equipped-helmet mapping exists in the paired runtime.
sourceEvidence.rejectedHairLook2: Narrow hair strip; visually rejected and used only as a motion anchor.
sourceEvidence.rejectedHelmetWil: Six horned/open-face families; none matches StateItem #344.

generation.equipmentIcon: Verified StateItem #344 remains the equipment-window icon and unique identity evidence; its old derived world pixels are not used.
generation.runtimeDirections: All eight runtime views are orthographic Godot renders of one complete procedural helmet geometry based on the user-approved redesign.
generation.deathDirections: Every N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW x F0/F1/F2/F3 cell is independently rendered from the same-row same-frame evidence record.
generation.authorship: Project-generated extension; not claimed as an original client world frame.
generation.runtimePixelGenerator: Godot 4.7 orthographic 3D renderer; no image-generation pixels are copied into the runtime atlases.
generation.scalePolicy: Fit each direction within the p75 width/height envelope and cap opaque visual mass at the same-direction client median; no arbitrary global reduction.
generation.deathPosePolicy: Use the exact same direction row and frame column in warrior_death.png and Hair.wil; invert that head vector through the documented Godot orthographic camera, render the complete helmet geometry, then centre it on the same-cell Hair anchor.

policy: Complete-client evidence first; generated art is explicitly separated from original client assets.
